name: Apple

window.note: 14 calendar days from the day you receive the product.

outcome.note: How refunds are paid wasn't confirmed in this check.

conditions.value: Within 14 days of receiving it, undamaged, with the original receipt or gift receipt. Your Apple receipt shows the last return date for each item.

processing.value: Within 10 business days after Apple receives and inspects the item; card refunds can take longer to appear

value.without: Original receipt or gift receipt required.

timing.value: Within 10 business days after Apple receives and inspects the item; card refunds can take longer to appear

methods.label: Return at an Apple Store
steps: Bring the item and receipt to an Apple Store
methods.note: Ten or more of the same product must go back to the store where they were bought.

methods.label: Start the return online or by phone
steps: Sign in to your Order List on apple.com, or call 1-800-MY-APPLE
Choose the item and start a return

unknowns.note: Apple has extended holiday returns in past years, but no official 2026 dates were found.
Not confirmed whether store returns refund to the original payment.
Not confirmed whether a mailed return only needs to be started within 14 days.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
